d: 'The Provenance: Journal of Forensic Semiotics is an academic publication exploring the intersection of sign theory, digital authorship, and criminology. It centers on the analysis of how traces, texts, and synthetic media carry (or fabricate) verifiable lineage, meaning, and authenticity in legal and investigative contexts' (cites Academia.edu +4).
